text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The weekly Gulf stock exchange report shows good sales in Kuwait and Bahrain and clear recession in Saudi Arabia and Muscat. Up to 1.6 billion shares worth $1.3 billion were traded.
- Saudi Arabia receives the third petrochemical tanker on Friday, third it has received in a $225 million deal.
- North American traders aim to boost Bahrain ties.
- Oman signed an agreement with a U.S. consultancy firm to develop stock market.
